stalled_rescale.quote2: the scale was first set by the set-R rule (0.382)

shield.text: the ' stalled' readout component, projected into the null space of layer 23's value projection
shield.quote: projected into the null space of `v_proj_23 ⊙ (1 + input_layernorm_23)`
shield.why: so that if the unit fires at log positions, layer 23's attention cannot carry it to the readout through values

notes: Every neuron is SwiGLU: activation = silu(slope · (gate − threshold)) · up, with gate and up weighted sums of standardised feature directions read at the input of the host MLP.
Each wire writes along the component of its label row orthogonal to the other three rows, so it moves one label logit only (direct path).
Effects marked 'Fable's own sessions' are from texts Fable wrote and labelled itself; 'disclosed windows' are the 200 labelled val windows WSP-B saw (in-sample).
